harvest.text: Delicate work, but we extracted valuable samples without triggering aggression. This material is incredibly valuable for medical research.

study.speaker: Sensor Officer
study.text: Fascinating data -- xenobiology readings that will be valuable to researchers. The bio-drones seem curious about our sensors but not hostile.

leave.text: You navigate out carefully. The bio-drones follow you to the edge of the breeding ground, then return to their membranes.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Navigation instruments are haywire. Up is down, distances warp. We have entered a spatial distortion field. A derelict somewhere inside contains the device generating it.

choices.label: Turn around before we get lost.

navigate.speaker: Engineer
navigate.text: Found the device and shut it down. The field collapses revealing an ancient alien waystation hidden beneath the distortion -- loaded with salvageable technology.

retreat.text: Getting out burns fuel as every turn takes you somewhere unexpected. Finally, instruments stabilize.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A scarred human with cybernetic eyes appears on holographic comms: "Join the Void Compact. A nation without borders, without corporations, without law. Every ship matters."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "Respectable. We do not force loyalty. But when the old powers fall, remember who offered you a seat at the table."

interest.speaker: Comm Channel
interest.text: "Smart. We'll be in touch with coordinates for a gathering. The Compact grows stronger every day."

insult.text: The hologram flickers with rage. Eight ships power weapons simultaneously.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: The nebula pulses with rhythmic light -- too regular to be natural. Captain... the entire nebula is a single organism. It seems curious about our ship.

communicate.speaker: Sensor Officer
communicate.text: It is communicating! Light patterns translate to navigational data -- hidden passages through its body that cut travel time. A gift from a living nebula.

fire.speaker: Engineer
fire.text: The nebula discharges static that fries half our electrical systems! It recoils away, wounded and frightened.

quiet.text: You pass through without incident. The nebula pulses gently as you leave, almost like a goodbye.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A Militia patrol broadcasts updated bounty listings. Three targets, three rewards. A pirate captain (300 credits), a Fringe smuggler (200 credits), or a mysterious raider (500 credits, location unknown).

pirate.speaker: Comm Channel
pirate.text: "Bounty registered. Target is hiding in a nearby asteroid field. Good hunting, captain."

smuggler.speaker: Comm Channel
smuggler.text: "Bounty registered. Last seen heading coreward. Stay sharp -- smugglers are slippery."

raider.speaker: Comm Channel
raider.text: "Bounty registered. We know nothing about this one except the damage they leave behind. 500 credits if you find them."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "Understood. The board is always open if you change your mind."

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Ion storm bearing down on a disabled civilian transport -- twelve crew trapped. A pirate is circling, waiting for the storm to disable their defenses. Storm hits in ninety seconds.

tow.speaker: Engineer
tow.text: Tow line rigged and holding! We are dragging them clear of the storm path. The pirate sees an easy mark gone and withdraws.

fight.text: Pirate destroyed, but the storm catches the transport. Some crew escape in pods. You could not save everyone.

both.speaker: Engineer
both.text: Towing under fire is insane -- but we did it. Transport clear, pirate driven off. Both ships took hits.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A gargantuan vessel glowing with internal furnaces -- a Forge Ship run by master craftsmen. "We build any module to order. Provide raw materials plus a crafting fee. Our specialty items outperform standard by 20%."

commission.speaker: Comm Channel
commission.text: "Fine work takes time, but it'll be worth the wait. Your module will be ready before you reach the next system."

trade.speaker: Comm Channel
trade.text: "Raw materials are always welcome. Fair prices for fair goods."

leave.speaker: Comm Channel
leave.text: "Come back when you have materials. The Forge is always open."

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Five armed ships where our contact should be. "Your friend sends their regards. Said you'd be carrying something valuable." This is a setup -- they know our ship configuration.

fight.text: They countered our loadout but did not account for raw determination. A bloody fight, but you break through.

negotiate.speaker: Comm Channel
negotiate.text: "Nothing to negotiate. Hand over your cargo or we take it from your wreckage." They open fire.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Hundreds of derelict ships orbit a dead planet in formation -- all pointing inward like a congregation frozen in prayer. A faint signal from the surface induces a compulsion to join them.

choices.label: Shut off the receiver and investigate.
Resist the signal and salvage the graveyard.

investigate.speaker: Engineer
investigate.text: The planet surface holds an alien beacon -- the source of the signal. We disabled it. The compulsion breaks and the derelicts drift free. The beacon itself is worth a fortune.

salvage.speaker: Engineer
salvage.text: With the receiver off, we strip derelicts freely. Centuries of accumulated ships means plenty of salvage.

leave.text: You pull away from the dead planet's influence. The fleet of derelicts shrinks in your rear sensors, still orbiting, still waiting.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A ship of impossible design hails with a voice like grinding metal: "I know what you want most. I can give it to you. The price is... flexible." It offers extreme boons for steep, strange prices.

offer.speaker: Comm Channel
offer.text: "5000 credits, yours. The price: jettison your oldest crew member into the void. A small thing, really, for such wealth."

refuse.text: You cut the channel. The impossible ship folds in on itself and vanishes. Your crew breathes easier.

refuse_deal.speaker: Comm Channel
refuse_deal.text: "A shame. Morality is such a fragile currency. I will find you again when you are more... desperate." The ship vanishes.

accept.text: The credits appear in your account. The entity vanishes. Your crew looks at you with something between fear and disgust.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: "Three jumps, 400 credits. Bring my cargo through alive." A merchant needs convoy escort. Two slow, fat haulers with no weapons.

accept.speaker: Sensor Officer
accept.text: First two jumps go smoothly. Third jump -- four pirate ships converge on the haulers. This is the real test.

fight.text: You intercept the pirates and keep both haulers intact. The merchant is ecstatic with a flawless escort.

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "Suit yourself. Hope the next captain has more guts."

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: A shimmering fractal structure drifts through space, refracting light into impossible colors. Beautiful -- until it fires crystalline shards like railgun rounds at our hull.

beam.speaker: Engineer
beam.text: Beam weapons resonate with the crystal structure -- it fractures apart! Massive yield of rare crystal and a unique refraction lens in the core.

projectile.text: Projectiles chip away at it slowly. It lands several shards on our hull before shattering. Decent salvage but we took hits.

flee.text: The entity pursues for a while, launching shards. One punches clean through a cargo section. Eventually you outpace it.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: "We bet everything on this colony mission. Supply route got cut off five days ago. No food left. We are drifting, conserving energy, waiting to die."

choices.label: Teach them to use their hydroponics bays.

share.speaker: Comm Channel
share.text: "You saved hundreds of lives today. When our colony is built, you will always have a home there."

teach.text: Your farming crew shows them their hydroponics bays were being used as storage. Within hours, the first growth cycles begin.

leave.text: You cannot feed everyone. The colony ships shrink behind you. Nobody on your crew speaks for a long time.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Heavily shielded installation hidden inside an asteroid -- no transponder, no markings. Automated defense platforms surround it. This is an ISD black site.

assault.text: The defense platforms are brutal but you break through. Inside: classified research, political prisoners, and experimental prototypes. The ISD will never forgive this.

choices.label: Free the prisoners and grab everything.

scan.speaker: Sensor Officer
scan.text: Scans logged. We have proof this facility exists. That information alone is valuable to the right people.

leave.text: You back away slowly. The defense platforms track you but do not fire. Message received.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Dense meteor shower incoming -- rocks ranging from pebbles to boulders. Shields will handle the small stuff but the big ones need manual evasion.

choices.label: Mine mineral-rich meteors as they pass.
Find shelter behind a large asteroid.

evade.text: Sharp flying keeps the worst of it off the hull. A few impacts but nothing critical. The shower clears.

mine.speaker: Engineer
mine.text: Mining crew snags mineral-rich rocks as they fly past -- free resources if you are quick enough. A few bigger rocks get through.

shelter.text: Tucked behind a massive asteroid, the shower passes overhead. Safe and sound.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A nervous trader on a private channel: "I shouldn't be telling you this, but there's an ambush set up three jumps ahead. Twelve ships, military grade. I owed a debt and this squares it."

choices.label: Thank them and alter our route.

alter.text: Course adjusted. The detour costs fuel but avoids a lethal trap.

warn.speaker: Comm Channel
warn.text: The targeted faction is deeply grateful for the warning. They owe you one.

counter.text: You arrive prepared. The ambushers expected a soft target, not a ship with weapons hot and shields up.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A Bulwark exercise has gone catastrophically wrong -- weapons malfunction caused live fire on their own ships. Confused, damaged ships are shooting at anything that moves. The commander is trying to restore order.

choices.label: Help relay commands to confused ships.
Stay clear and wait it out.

relay.speaker: Comm Channel
relay.text: Hailing panicked ships, relaying the commander's orders. One by one, weapons go cold. The Bulwark commander is enormously grateful.

wait.text: Stray fire clips your hull twice before the chaos subsides. The Bulwark fleet limps away, embarrassed.

flee.text: You burn clear of the exercise zone. Explosions flash behind you as the Bulwark fleet sorts itself out.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: A ship has locked a siphon device onto our fuel tank and is draining us! "Hold still, this'll only take a minute. Resist and I'll take your whole ship."

choices.label: Hard engine burn to break the siphon.
Precision fire on the siphon attachment.

burn.speaker: Engineer
burn.text: Siphon torn free! Cost us fuel to break loose but we are clear. The pirate curses and retreats.

shoot.text: Precise shots sever the siphon. The pirate, now disarmed of their main tool, tries to flee.

fight.text: The fuel pirate is a veteran -- tough ship, clever tactics. But you prevail. Their hold is full of stolen fuel.

choices.label: Reclaim our fuel and then some.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A dozen ships float around a vessel broadcasting a sermon: "The Void speaks to those who listen. In the space between stars, truth lives." The preacher invites you to "hear the silence."

choices.label: Power down all systems for sixty seconds.

listen.text: Sixty seconds of total silence. No engines, no comms, nothing. Your crew reports feeling genuinely refreshed -- something about the experience resets mental fatigue.

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "The Void is patient. It will wait." The fleet drifts on, their sermon fading into background radiation.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Engine just exploded -- not failed, EXPLODED. Someone planted a charge. We are adrift, bleeding atmosphere. And a ship is approaching -- the saboteur, here to finish the job.

repair.speaker: Engineer
repair.text: Patched enough engine power to maneuver while trading fire with the assassin. They did not expect us to get moving again so fast. They break off.

fight.text: Without engines, you are a sitting target -- but your weapons still work. The assassin underestimates your gunnery and pays for it.

distress.speaker: Comm Channel
distress.text: A passing patrol responds to the distress call, spooking the assassin into retreating. Lucky timing.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A charismatic rogue hails: "I've got the plan, the codes, and the inside man. What I need is a ship fast enough to outrun the response fleet. We're robbing a COTAC executive transport -- 10,000 credits. Your cut is 40%."

choices.label: Turn her in for a reward.

accept.speaker: Comm Channel
accept.text: "Now we're talking! Meet me at these coordinates in twelve hours. Bring your best pilot."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "Your loss, captain. Fortune favors the bold." She winks and the channel closes.

turnin.text: You report her coordinates to a COTAC security patrol. They pay a modest finder's fee.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Thousands of bioluminescent space creatures streaming past -- an alien migration. They range from sparrow-sized to whale-sized, all moving with purposeful grace.

follow.speaker: Sensor Officer
follow.text: The migration leads to a protostar nursery -- beautiful and rich in exotic minerals. The creatures settle here to feed and breed.

study.speaker: Sensor Officer
study.text: Valuable xenobiology data collected. The creatures seem unbothered by our scans.

navigate.text: Careful flying through the migration. A few gentle bumps from curious creatures but no damage. Beautiful sight.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Two bounty hunters arrived simultaneously -- both after us and both after each other. "That's MY mark!" They start fighting each other.

choices.label: Wait for the survivor and negotiate.

flee.text: You burn out while they are locked in combat. Neither can break off to pursue.

fight.text: Both hunters are wounded from fighting each other. You pick them off efficiently. Both carry bounty rewards themselves.

wait.speaker: Comm Channel
wait.text: The survivor is battered and more willing to negotiate. For double the original bounty, they will walk away and erase the contract.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A medical frigate surrounded by damaged ships. The doctor aboard treats anyone regardless of faction. "Out here, there are no enemies, only patients."

choices.label: Ask about derelicts with medical modules.

heal.speaker: Medic
heal.text: The doctor patches up our injured crew with impressive skill. Modest fee but worth every credit.

trade.speaker: Comm Channel
trade.text: "Medical supplies for pharmaceutical compounds -- a fair exchange. These will help my patients enormously."

intel.speaker: Comm Channel
intel.text: "I know every wreck with intact medical gear in this sector. Here -- consider it payment for helping keep people alive."

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Something grabbed us -- a gravity mine pulling us toward a kill zone! Three pirate ships waiting with weapons ready. The pull is constant and strong.

choices.label: Find and destroy the mine generator.
Fight the pirates while being dragged.

destroy.speaker: Sensor Officer
destroy.text: Located the generator -- a shielded device in the debris. Precision fire takes it out. The pull dies and the pirates lose their advantage.

fight.text: Fighting while being dragged through their crossfire is brutal. You prevail but take heavy damage.

burn.speaker: Engineer
burn.text: Fuel burning at five times normal rate just to hold position. We barely crawl free. The pirates give chase but lose interest.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A terrified prospector hails from behind an asteroid: "I saw COTAC ships dumping toxic waste into a populated system's water supply. I have the recordings. They've been hunting me for two days."

choices.label: Escort the witness to a Militia station.
Take the recordings and deliver them yourself.

escort.speaker: Comm Channel
escort.text: COTAC interceptors appear en route but you fight them off. The witness files a formal complaint at the Militia outpost. They hand you coordinates to a rich mineral deposit as thanks.

take.text: The recordings are damning. COTAC will be furious when this gets out.

leave.speaker: Comm Channel
leave.text: "Please -- they'll kill me!" The prospector's voice fades as you pull away.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Derelict carrier ahead -- fighter bay doors open, no fighters visible. As we approach, automated defense systems are waking up. Turrets tracking us.

choices.label: Target the command antenna to disable defenses.

antenna.speaker: Engineer
antenna.text: One precise shot to the command antenna and everything goes dark. Turrets droop, autopilot fighters crash into each other. The carrier is ours to salvage.

fight.text: Crewless fighters are erratic but unpredictable. You take hits but destroy them all. Salvage is substantial.

retreat.text: Discretion over valor. The carrier's defenses do not pursue beyond their perimeter.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: The wealthiest independent trader in the sector -- "Prince" Orin Vask -- offers exclusive deals: premium buy prices and 15% below market on rare modules. But first, a loyalty test: deliver "legitimate goods" to a specific station.

accept.speaker: Comm Channel
accept.text: "Excellent. Deliver this cargo -- discreetly -- and you'll have access to my private stock. Don't get caught."

trade.speaker: Comm Channel
trade.text: "Fair enough. Standard rates then. But you're missing out on the real deals."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "A cautious soul. I respect that. Perhaps next time, captain."

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Three hull breaches simultaneously! Micro-meteorite cluster punched through in three places. Air venting fast -- sixty seconds to seal them all or we lose someone.

choices.label: Rush to seal all three breaches.
Seal two and evacuate the third section.

seal.speaker: Engineer
seal.text: All three sealed with seconds to spare. Close call -- everyone is shaken but alive.

evacuate.speaker: Engineer
evacuate.text: Two breaches sealed, third section evacuated and locked down. We lost some cargo to vacuum but the crew is safe.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: "Fresh meat! Five rounds, five opponents, five chances to die gloriously! Entry fee is 100 credits. Grand prize: 1000 credits and a combat-hardened recruit."

enter.text: Round after round of brutal close-quarters combat. Your best fighter takes a beating but wins all five. The crowd goes wild.

watch.text: The fights are savage but entertaining. Your crew enjoys the spectacle and makes some bets.

leave.speaker: Comm Channel
leave.text: "Cowards! Get out of my arena!" The Crucible's crew jeers as you depart.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: "Your outstanding balance with COTAC Mining Division is 500 credits, including interest and penalties." Your science officer notes this does not match any known COTAC debt code -- likely fabricated.

choices.label: Pay to make them go away.

pay.text: Credits transferred. They leave without another word. That was probably a scam.

dispute.speaker: Comm Channel
dispute.text: You cite specific COTAC corporate codes. The officer sputters and disconnects. Scam confirmed.

refuse.text: The enforcement vessel powers weapons. Well-armed and clearly experienced at shaking people down.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Deep in a nebula, a ship covered in improvised repairs and organic growth. Old Jace hasn't spoken to anyone in twenty years. He is a brilliant scientist who went into hiding after creating something dangerous.

choices.label: Ask him to join the crew.

trade.speaker: Comm Channel
trade.text: "News! Real news! In exchange, let me teach your science crew some advanced techniques. And take this research data -- I have no use for it anymore."

recruit.speaker: Comm Channel
recruit.text: "Leave my nebula? No. Never. But I'll trade knowledge for news anytime you visit. This is my home."

leave.text: The hermit waves through a porthole as you depart. Twenty years alone -- hard to imagine.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: No warning -- three ships open fire simultaneously from three directions! Autocannons, pulse lasers, missiles. This is a professional hit.

choices.label: Focus fire on one to break the formation.

fight.text: Chaotic firefight from all angles. You take hits but dish out worse. One ship goes down and the remaining two recalculate odds.

focus.text: Concentrated fire drops one attacker fast. The other two, seeing a professional crew, disengage. They do not die for free.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: A ship of completely alien design -- no match in any database. It broadcasts complex mathematical sequences. This is genuine first contact.

math.speaker: Sensor Officer
math.text: They respond! A slow, fascinating dialogue through mathematics. They share navigational data for the region -- a gesture of goodwill between strangers.

greet.text: The aliens seem confused by non-mathematical communication but sense peaceful intent. They transmit a simple gift of data before departing.

weapons.speaker: Sensor Officer
weapons.text: The alien ship detects our weapons powering up. It vanishes instantly -- and three more appear, much larger. Warning shots bracket our ship before they all disappear.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A prison colony on a nearby asteroid has erupted in riot. The warden broadcasts: "Any armed vessel -- immediate assistance needed! Prisoners have taken hostages!"

warden.speaker: Comm Channel
warden.text: Fighting armed, desperate prisoners is ugly work, but order is restored. The warden pays well.

prisoners.text: Many inmates are political prisoners. You help them reach escape ships. The Fringe network is deeply grateful.

leave.text: You pull away as the riot intensifies. Explosions flash across the asteroid's surface.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: An annual solar sailing competition -- ships riding radiation pressure from a nearby star. Entry is free. Engineering determines sail optimization. First place: 300 credits.

race.text: Elegant flying, precise sail adjustments. You cross the finish line with an optimized configuration that impresses the veterans.

watch.text: Beautiful to watch. The other racers share stories at the finish line and your crew enjoys the atmosphere.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: We have entered a pocket of dense dark matter. Speed dropping, fuel consumption spiking, hull groaning under added gravitational stress.

choices.label: Study the visual distortions at the center.

adjust.speaker: Engineer
adjust.text: Systems compensated. We are through the pocket with manageable fuel loss.

study.speaker: Sensor Officer
study.text: The dark matter density creates visual distortions -- glimpses of other places. Mapped them to actual coordinates revealing hidden locations of value.

reverse.text: Backing out before the density gets worse. Lost some fuel fighting the drag.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: "They know you've been playing both sides. A combined Castellan-COTAC task force is being assembled. You have one hour to leave the sector."

flee.text: You burn hard for the sector boundary, abandoning any local mission progress. Safety first.

fight.text: Six ships arrive -- a real threat. But defeating them sends a powerful message: you are not to be trifled with.

start.text: In the middle of a ship graveyard, a woman lives alone on a platform of welded hulls. She calls herself the Oracle. "They told me about you," she says, knowing things she should not.

choices.label: Ask how she knows these things.

listen.text: Her advice is cryptic but seems genuinely useful -- warnings about dangers ahead, hints about hidden opportunities. Your crew finds her unsettling but compelling.

ask.text: "The dead ships speak, child. Everyone who ever crewed these hulks left a piece of themselves behind. I just listen." She smiles and offers you a piece of scrap that hums with strange energy.

leave.text: You depart quickly. The Oracle waves from her perch, still smiling. She knew you would leave. She knows everything.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: "Mayday! Engine fire! Suppressors offline -- if the fire reaches the fuel cells, we are done! Forty seconds!"

choices.label: Breach their hull near the fire to vent it.

dock.speaker: Engineer
dock.text: Our team reaches their suppressors and gets them back online. Fire contained with seconds to spare. The grateful captain offers cargo and crew as thanks.

breach.text: Precision weapons fire punctures the hull near the fire, venting it to vacuum. Risky but effective. They are alive and grateful.

choices.label: Patch the hole and move on.

leave.text: You maintain distance as the freighter burns. The explosion lights up the void moments later.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A Fringe operative contacts you secretly: "Medical supplies needed at that blockaded station. Militia won't check a ship with clean papers. 600 credits."

choices.label: Run the blockade with clean reputation.

clean.speaker: Comm Channel
clean.text: The Militia patrols wave you through without a second glance. Supplies delivered, credits paid. Nobody the wiser.

forged.text: The forged papers hold up under scrutiny. Barely. You deliver the supplies and collect payment, heart pounding.

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "Understood. Can't blame you for not wanting to run a Militia blockade."

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Strange noises from the cargo hold -- scratching, thumping, something that sounds like breathing. Something alive got in at the last station and it is eating through our hull from the inside.

choices.label: Send a team to contain it immediately.
Leave it for now and monitor.

contain.speaker: Sensor Officer
contain.text: Contained! It is an alien parasite that feeds on metal. Xenobiologists will pay well for this specimen.

flush.speaker: Engineer
flush.text: Hold vented. The creature is dead but it already ate through some hull plating. At least the problem is solved.

wait.speaker: Engineer
wait.text: Big mistake. The thing grew fast -- now it is the size of a person and has breached two bulkheads. We need to deal with it NOW.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Representatives from all eight factions at a rare summit. A terrorist threat has been detected. They are hiring additional security. Prevent the attack and earn reputation with every faction.

accept.text: Patrolling the perimeter, you intercept saboteurs and relay intelligence. The summit concludes safely thanks to your vigilance.

decline.text: You depart as the summit begins. A rare opportunity missed.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: A void leviathan the size of a moon is passing through the sector. Its gravitational wake tumbles everything -- ships, asteroids, stations. Pirates are picking off victims in the chaos.

choices.label: Navigate the turbulence and avoid pirates.
Fight the pirates in the chaos.

navigate.text: Masterful piloting threads you through gravitational eddies. The leviathan passes, indifferent to the mayhem in its wake.

fight.text: Pirates adapted to the turbulence are tough opponents. You prevail but the gravitational chaos batters your hull throughout.

ride.text: Riding the wake accelerates you to incredible speed. The forces are punishing but you emerge far ahead of your planned route.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Yanked out of warp by an interdiction device. "Welcome to nowhere. Your warp drive won't work until we turn off the jammer. So let's negotiate." They want 40% of your cargo.

jammer.speaker: Sensor Officer
jammer.text: Located the jammer satellite in nearby debris. Precision fire disables it -- warp drive coming back online. The pirates scramble.

fight.text: Without warp, you are stuck here anyway. Might as well fight. The pirates are tough but you prevail and disable their jammer.

negotiate.speaker: Comm Channel
negotiate.text: "20% and we part as friends. Final offer." They accept. Cheaper than a fight.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Old stress fracture just gave way and it is cascading -- one plate buckles, then the next. The ship is coming apart while we fly it!

choices.label: Shore up failing sections with engineering.
Have hauling crew physically brace sections.
Make for the nearest station at full speed.

shore.speaker: Engineer
shore.text: Engineering team works frantically, welding and bracing. The cascade stops after four sections. Damaged but stable.

brace.text: Hauling crew physically holds failing sections together while engineering patches the critical points. Teamwork saves the ship.

speed.speaker: Engineer
speed.text: Racing for the station while sections peel off behind us. We make it, barely, trailing debris.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A greasy-looking man on a gaudy ship: "Need credits? No questions, no background check. Up to 2000 right now. Interest is 150% within thirty days."

loan.speaker: Comm Channel
loan.text: "Pleasure doing business. Remember -- thirty days. My collectors are... enthusiastic."

fence.speaker: Comm Channel
fence.text: "I see, I see. Sixty percent value, no questions. Efficient and discreet."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "Suit yourself. Everyone needs money eventually."

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Sensors show thirty ships approaching in formation -- but visual shows empty space. Then ghost images flicker: translucent warships from another era, crewed by shadows.

choices.label: Recalibrate shields to filter the effect.

filter.speaker: Sensor Officer
filter.text: Shield recalibration filters the worst effects. The ghosts pass through the ship as harmless light. Crew is unsettled but unharmed.

power.text: The ghosts pass through the ship. Your crew experiences vivid hallucinations of their worst memories. Several need medical attention afterward.

avoid.text: Detour around the ghost fleet. Costs fuel but spares the crew the experience.

start.text: Coordinates from a bathroom wall lead to a hidden asteroid cache. Inside: 500 credits, illegal stimulants, military weapon components, and a dead body with a note: "If you're reading this, I didn't make it. -Sable"

choices.label: Take just the credits and components.

grab.text: Everything loaded. As you pull away, an ISD scanner beam sweeps the asteroid. They were watching. But you were fast enough.

selective.text: Credits and components secured. You leave the illegal goods for whoever comes next.

leave.text: You back away. Sable's last gift stays untouched in the cold dark.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A Castellan battlecruiser breaks formation and fires on its own fleet! Its captain broadcasts: "I will not carry out these orders. The admiralty has gone mad. Any ship that stands with justice, stand with me."

defector.text: A massive, chaotic capital ship battle. The defector's crew fights with desperate conviction. You help them break free of the loyalist formation.

loyalist.speaker: Comm Channel
loyalist.text: "COTAC and Castellan thank you for your loyalty. The traitor will be dealt with."

flee.text: You burn clear of two capital ships trading broadsides. Not your war.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Miners camped on a massive comet, harvesting ice for fuel and water. "We go where the comet goes. Simple life." They sell fuel below market and buy entertainment items at premium prices.

fuel.speaker: Comm Channel
fuel.text: "Best prices in the sector. No overhead when your home rides for free."

trade.speaker: Comm Channel
trade.text: "A bottle of decent alcohol for the best mining coordinates in the sector? Deal!" The lead miner pulls out a hand-drawn chart.

chat.text: The comet riders are friendly and full of stories. Your crew enjoys the break from routine.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Total system failure -- EMP knocked out everything! Lights dead, engines cut, weapons offline. Five minutes of breathable air on chemical backup. And sensors just came back showing a ship approaching.

weapons.text: Weapons online just as the looter ship enters range. They were not expecting a ship that can fight back. A few shots and they flee.

engines.text: Engines restart and you burn away from the approaching looter. They pursue briefly but give up when you reach full speed.

everything.speaker: Engineer
everything.text: Trying to restart everything at once causes a cascade failure. Some systems come back, some do not. The looter arrives while you are still half-dark.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: A clandestine gathering of ships marks a flesh market -- traffickers selling kidnapped people. The operation is slick and well-defended.

buy.text: You purchase the freedom of a young engineer. Expensive but they are alive and free. They insist on joining your crew.

authorities.speaker: Comm Channel
authorities.text: A Militia patrol responds to your encrypted report. They move in force, scattering the traffickers.

assault.text: A direct assault on well-armed traffickers. Costly but effective -- dozens freed, market shut down.

leave.text: You slip away. The screams of the captives echo in your crew's nightmares for weeks.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A lawyer ship tracks you down: "My client, the late Devros Kain, has named your vessel as beneficiary. The inheritance includes 700 credits, star charts, and a family heirloom -- an alien artifact of unknown function."

accept.speaker: Comm Channel
accept.text: "Congratulations. Be warned -- Mr. Kain's family is contesting the will. You may receive... communications from them."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "Unusual but within your rights. The estate will go to the secondary beneficiary."

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: "Under Bulwark Defense Act 7, all capable vessels in this sector are temporarily drafted. A hostile fleet is inbound. Compliance is not optional."

join.text: The battle is chaotic but the Bulwark fleet absorbs most damage. You survive with some hits and earn a share of the loot.

protest.speaker: Comm Channel
protest.text: "Protest noted. You will comply regardless. Failure to comply results in impoundment." They are not bluffing.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: The corpse of an enormous void creature drifts through space -- kilometers long. Already attracting scavenger ships. Valuable biological compounds, exotic gases, and partially digested ship remains inside.

choices.label: Focus on the digested ship remains.

harvest.speaker: Engineer
harvest.text: Rich biological compounds extracted from the creature's tissues. Competition with other scavengers is fierce but fair.

salvage.speaker: Engineer
salvage.text: Found partially digested ships in the gut -- still containing salvageable cargo and components. Grim but profitable.

leave.text: Too many scavengers already. You move on to less contested territory.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: A focused beam lances through our shields from extreme range -- a sniper ship firing from beyond our weapon range! They are built around one massive long-range lance battery.

choices.label: Close the distance at full burn.

close.text: Burning straight at them, taking hits but closing fast. At range, they are fragile -- one good volley and they come apart. Evidence aboard reveals who hired them.

evade.text: Dodging periodic shots while closing the gap. Fewer hits but slower approach. Once in range, the sniper's fragile ship cannot survive your broadside.

start.speaker: Medic
start.text: A crew member has snapped -- locked themselves in the engine room, threatening to overload the reactor. "I'll show you what nothing really looks like." Sixty seconds before meltdown.

choices.label: Cut power to the engine room remotely.

talk.speaker: Medic
talk.text: Careful words, calm voice. They break down sobbing. The reactor powers down. They need treatment but they will recover -- and come back stronger.

force.text: Door breached, crew member restrained. Reactor safed with seconds to spare. Rough but effective.

cut.speaker: Engineer
cut.text: Power cut remotely. The reactor begins emergency shutdown. The crew member collapses in the dark, exhausted.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A traditional dueling ground -- two captains settling a cargo dispute ship-to-ship. They need a neutral witness. The loser accuses the winner of cheating and fires outside agreed terms.

choices.label: Intervene to protect the honest dueler.
Side with the cheater for their cargo.

protect.text: You intercept the cheater's illegal fire. The honest dueler is grateful and offers trade connections.

observe.text: The cheater destroys the honest dueler before anyone can react. A dishonorable outcome that leaves a bad taste.

cheater.text: You help the cheater finish off their opponent. They share the cargo -- blood money.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Dense radiation belt across our course. Going around costs fuel and time. Going through requires strong shields and good engineering. Halfway through, a stranded ship with dead shields -- crew dying of radiation poisoning.

tow.text: Towing through the radiation costs additional exposure, but both ships make it out. The grateful crew includes a talented engineer who wants to join you.

push.text: Through the belt with manageable exposure. The stranded ship shrinks in your rear sensors.

around.text: The long way around. Safe but costly.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Two pirate captains in open war -- their fleets tearing each other apart. Captain Vrex (8 ships) offers 600 credits. Captain Sonya (6 ships) offers 400 credits plus a prototype cloaking device.

vrex.speaker: Comm Channel
vrex.text: Vrex's larger fleet, bolstered by your firepower, overwhelms Sonya. Victory is decisive.

sonya.speaker: Comm Channel
sonya.text: Sonya's smaller fleet fights smarter with your help. Vrex falls. The prototype cloaking device is yours.

play.text: Careful manipulation turns both fleets against each other more aggressively. They destroy each other while you watch.

hunt.text: Both fleets are bleeding. You pick off stragglers from each side, collecting bounties.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Dozens of emergency beacons activating simultaneously -- far too many to be real. An emergency beacon farm designed to overwhelm rescue response. One real distress signal is hidden among the fakes.

choices.label: Analyze signals to find the real one.

analyze.speaker: Sensor Officer
analyze.text: Found it -- a Xenoculture diplomatic ship under attack! The attackers did not expect anyone to sort real from fake. We arrive in time.

nearest.text: False beacon. Then another. By the time you find the real one, the Xenoculture ship has taken heavy damage, but you save the survivors.

ignore.text: You cannot sort real from fake and will not waste time. Somewhere in the noise, someone needed help.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: We picked up void barnacles at the last station -- small organisms metabolizing our hull metal. Not immediately dangerous but they are slowing us down and will cause damage over time.

choices.label: Harvest the barnacles before removing them.
EVA crew to scrape them off.
Fly close to a star to burn them off.

harvest.speaker: Sensor Officer
harvest.text: Void barnacle extract is valuable for medical compounds. We harvested a good batch before removing the rest.

remove.speaker: Engineer
remove.text: EVA team scraped them off in about an hour. Ship is back to normal speed.

star.speaker: Engineer
star.text: The heat kills the barnacles but scorches some exterior panels. Effective if crude.

start.text: A hooded figure on a station slips you a data chip: "I work inside COTAC upper management. This data could bring down their illegal operations. Deliver it to a Militia outpost. I can't do it myself." The chip is broadcasting a faint tracker.

choices.label: Deliver the data to the Militia.

deliver.speaker: Comm Channel
deliver.text: COTAC goons show up one jump later but you fight them off. The Militia is extremely grateful for the evidence.

sell.speaker: Comm Channel
sell.text: COTAC pays well to bury the evidence. The informant's fate is sealed.

destroy.text: The chip crunches underfoot. Nobody gets what they want. Safest option for you.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: The nebula ahead crackles with constant electrical discharges -- a thunderhead region where static buildup fries circuits. Inside: a motherlode of ionized rare elements.

choices.label: Enter with shields down and grounded hull.

grounded.speaker: Engineer
grounded.text: Good call dropping shields -- they attract charge. With proper grounding, we navigate through and collect ionized elements along the way.

shields.speaker: Engineer
shields.text: Shields attracted every discharge in the nebula. Massive electrical damage before we figured out to drop them.

around.text: The safe route adds time and fuel but keeps the ship intact.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Two fighters locked in a close-quarters dogfight -- a Militia pilot losing to a pirate ace called Sidewinder Kel. The Militia pilot is going down fast.

militia.speaker: Comm Channel
militia.text: With your support, the Militia pilot survives. Sidewinder Kel's ship goes down. Bounty collected.

pirate.text: You help Sidewinder Kel finish off the Militia pilot. The pirate ace nods respect and shares salvage.

leave.text: The pirate wins and turns on you, flush with victory and aggression. Sidewinder Kel is a formidable opponent.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Research station adrift -- catastrophic internal damage. Not from attack but from something breaking out. Claw marks gouge through steel. Containment pods shattered.

search.text: Intact samples found in a sealed wing -- valuable xenobiology specimens. Something moves in the corridor behind you. Time to go.

logs.speaker: Sensor Officer
logs.text: Research logs detail experiments on void organism biology that went catastrophically wrong. The data alone is valuable to scientists.

leave.text: Smart. Whatever broke out of those containment pods, you want no part of it.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: An unusual energy field is creating resonance feedback in our shields -- they are either amplified to double strength or destabilized to half, depending on frequency tuning.

choices.label: Tune shields to the beneficial frequency.
Drop shields entirely to avoid the effect.

tune.speaker: Engineer
tune.text: Shields tuned to the amplification frequency. They hum at double strength -- a significant advantage in this region.

drop.text: Running without shields through an unknown region. Nerve-wracking but the resonance cannot affect what is not there.

choices.label: Raise shields once we are clear.

push.speaker: Engineer
push.text: Shields destabilized -- the resonance cut our protection in half. A pirate takes advantage and lands hits that should have bounced.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Hundreds of ships from every faction drift in solemn formation. A broadcast repeats: "We honor Captain Elena Ironwing Marsh -- pirate, admiral, legend. All are welcome to pay respects."

choices.label: Join the formation and attend the ceremony.

attend.speaker: Veteran Captain
attend.text: You fly in formation for a few quiet minutes. At the wake, old captains trade stories. One slides you a data chip: "Ironwing would want someone bold to have this."

distant.text: You dip your running lights in salute. A few ships flash theirs in acknowledgment. Your crew stands in respectful silence.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A modified industrial ship locks you in a tractor beam, dragging you toward its cargo bay. "Fresh salvage, boys! Still has a crew -- we sell them separate."

overload.speaker: Engineer
overload.text: Engines at 140% -- the beam snaps. Drive took damage but you are free.

shoot.speaker: Sensor Officer
shoot.text: Direct hit on the emitter! Beam is down. They are scrambling but not giving up.

surrender.text: They strip your cargo and credits. "Smart choice." They shove you out and warp off laughing.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A mining ship is pinned against a rock by an asteroid, venting atmosphere. "Mayday! Six crew -- hull giving way!"

evacuate.speaker: Medic
evacuate.text: Six miners pile into your airlock. Their foreman: "We owe you everything. Put us to work, captain."

push.speaker: Engineer
push.text: Full thrust against the asteroid. Hull groans -- rock shifts. Mining ship floats free. "Take our ore. It is yours."

leave.text: You pull away as their calls grow desperate. Your crew will not meet your eyes.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Explosion off port -- no visible source! Another starboard! Cloaked proximity mines everywhere.

detect.speaker: Sensor Officer
detect.text: Got them on sensors. The field protects a pirate base in that asteroid. We can raid it or slip out.

choices.label: Slip out and report to Militia.

punch.speaker: Engineer
punch.text: Through -- but hull took a serious beating. Several detonations along our flanks.

reverse.text: You back out carefully, taking one more hit. The base stays hidden for now.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Underground fighting ring in a station. A promoter: "200 credits entry, winner takes the 800 pot. Interested?"

fight.text: Your fighter faces a massive alien champion. Brutal exchange -- your fighter stands victorious!

watch.text: Savage but entertaining. Your crew cheers and places side bets.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Sector nav beacon broadcasting false coordinates -- pirate override device. Ships vanishing into a dead zone.

remove.speaker: Engineer
remove.text: Device removed -- four pirate ships just dropped out of warp.

deadzone.speaker: Sensor Officer
deadzone.text: Three ships found. Two wrecks, one with survivors. We pull them out.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Powerful solar wind creating particle waves. Experienced pilots surf these for fast fuel-free travel.

surf.text: Your pilot catches the wave perfectly -- riding charged particles at incredible speed. The crew whoops.

collect.speaker: Sensor Officer
collect.text: We harvest trace exotic particles from the solar wind. Valuable stuff.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Five armed ships approach. "Nice ship. Shame if something happened to it. 100 credits a month for guaranteed safety."

pay.speaker: Comm Channel
pay.text: "Smart. Nobody touches you in this sector." They pocket the credits and leave.

refuse.speaker: Comm Channel
refuse.text: "Wrong answer." All five ships power weapons.

report.speaker: Sensor Officer
report.text: We broadcast their location on Militia frequencies. They scatter when they detect the transmission.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Nearby wormhole collapsing -- spatial distortion pulling everything in! Seconds before gravity becomes inescapable!

choices.label: Grab what the wormhole spits out.

engines.speaker: Engineer
engines.text: Engines at maximum! We claw free as something shoots from the wormhole -- alien wreckage.

corridor.speaker: Engineer
corridor.text: Safe corridor found. We thread through as alien cargo tumbles from the dying wormhole.

grab.text: You lunge for alien wreckage. Hull scrapes against impossible forces but you snag a cargo pod.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Cargo was infested with void rats. Everywhere -- chewing wiring, contaminating food, biting crew.

choices.label: Buy premium rations from a nearby merchant.

traps.speaker: Engineer
traps.text: Found the nest and the queen. One messy fight later, infestation done. Minor wiring damage.

vent.speaker: Engineer
vent.text: Cargo bays vented. Rats gone, but so are our stored goods.

buy.speaker: Comm Channel
buy.text: Premium rations at triple price. Crew is grateful, wallet is not.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Twelve alien warships surround you. "Your species damaged our sacred site. Return for judgment or be destroyed."

choices.label: Explain we had nothing to do with it.

explain.speaker: Comm Channel
explain.text: An elder speaks: "This one carries no guilt. Release them -- with a warning."

submit.speaker: Comm Channel
submit.text: After a tense trial, you are found innocent. Formal apology and compensation.

flee.speaker: Engineer
flee.text: Engines full, weaving through their formation. Shots sizzle past. By luck, you find a gap.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Solo mechanic in a ship crammed with tools: "I fix things. Whatever is broken, I have seen worse. Half station prices."

rep_opt.speaker: The Mechanic
rep_opt.text: She works fast. Hull gleams where patched. "Good as slightly used."

tune.speaker: The Mechanic
tune.text: An hour in your engine room, muttering and adjusting. "Ten percent better efficiency. You are welcome."

browse.speaker: The Mechanic
browse.text: Her salvage pile has a few gems. She mentions she is looking for an apprentice.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Remote colony priests "read the void currents" to intercept lost cargo. "Bring an offering and we share our technique."

offer.speaker: Comm Channel
offer.text: Ritual performed, navigation chip handed over. Their drift prediction technique actually works.

browse.speaker: Comm Channel
browse.text: Mostly junk, but a few valuable items. You haggle for the good stuff.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Seven fast attack ships in wolfpack formation, all directions. Terrorizing this route for weeks.

leader.speaker: Sensor Officer
leader.text: Pack leader down -- the rest scatter! Loot from dozens of raids drifts free.

scatter.text: You damage several but they regroup fast. Long fight ahead.

flee.speaker: Engineer
flee.text: They are faster individually but formation breaks as they chase. You slip through a gap.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Space looks wrong -- colors shifting, physics off. Other versions of our ship flickering in and out. Dimensional bleed zone.

reach.speaker: Sensor Officer
reach.text: Window stabilizes -- you grab a component from an alternate reality. Alien, familiar, unsettling.

study.speaker: Sensor Officer
study.text: Incredible sensor data captured. Science community will pay well.

flee.text: You burn out of the bleed zone. Crew exhales as stars look normal again.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Militia soldiers who stole a frigate rather than bomb civilians: "We are soldiers, not murderers. We need fuel and a heading."

help.speaker: Comm Channel
help.text: "Thank you. If any of us can serve on your ship, we would be honored."

turnin.speaker: Comm Channel
turnin.text: Militia collects them. "Good citizen." The deserters go quietly, eyes full of betrayal.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Massive void storm forces us to shelter behind an asteroid with a pirate, merchant, Militia patrol, and Xenoculture vessel. Weapons down.

chat.text: Strange truce. The pirate shares a trade route tip. Militia officer passes a bounty listing. Merchant sells at cost.

quiet.text: You wait out the storm in silence. When it clears, everyone goes separate ways.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Main engine cascading into connected systems! Power destabilizing, life support flickering. Drifting and helpless.

restart.speaker: Engineer
restart.text: Prioritizing life support and navigation. Ugly, but enough to limp to port.

beacon.speaker: Comm Channel
beacon.text: Passing ship offers a tow -- for 400 credits. Highway robbery, but we cannot negotiate.

emergency.speaker: Engineer
emergency.text: Rerouting power through secondary conduits. We lose non-essentials but core holds.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: An alien collection beam pulls you into a space arena. "Honored warrior! Fight in our great games and earn freedom!"

fight.text: Three rounds of escalating combat. Your ship takes damage but emerges victorious. The alien crowd roars.

demand.speaker: Comm Channel
demand.text: "You refuse the honor? Disappointing." They release you after scrambling some systems.

negotiate.speaker: Comm Channel
negotiate.text: One round: win and go free with a reward. Lose and they take a module.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Drug manufacturer in a mobile lab: "Combat stims, focus enhancers, pain blockers -- whatever your crew needs."

stims.speaker: Comm Channel
stims.text: "Your fighters will thank you -- until the crash hits." Unmarked containers loaded.

medical.speaker: Comm Channel
medical.text: "Legit stuff. Pain blockers and immune boosters. No side effects."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "Suit yourself." The lab ship cloaks and vanishes.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Salvaging in a graveyard when derelicts light up! Pirates using dead ships as camouflage. Six ships powering weapons.

weave.text: Threading between hulks, using wrecks as cover. Their ambush becomes a disadvantage.

fight.text: Head-on against six ships with no cover. Bold.

reverse.speaker: Engineer
reverse.text: Backing out through the graveyard. They pursue but wreckage slows them.

start.speaker: Medic
start.text: Passed through an alien spore cloud. Spores in air systems. Crew hallucinating -- and they do not want it to stop.

treat.speaker: Medic
treat.text: Air sealed, crew treated. A few seem disappointed the hallucinations stopped.

collect.speaker: Medic
collect.text: Farming crew recognizes these as valuable xenobotanical specimens. Samples collected while treating the worst cases.

wait.speaker: Medic
wait.text: Spores root in waste systems. Hallucinations stop but cleanup will take weeks.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Independent operative: "Election at Freeport. Corporate candidate sells to COTAC. People's candidate needs muscle."

security.speaker: Comm Channel
security.text: Your crew stands guard. No trouble. People's candidate wins by a landslide.

investigate.speaker: Sensor Officer
investigate.text: Corporate candidate is on COTAC payroll. You leak the intel. Scandal erupts.

bribe.speaker: Comm Channel
bribe.text: COTAC pays well for sabotage. People's candidate loses.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: A torpedo armed itself in the tube! Warhead is live -- any jolt could detonate inside the ship.

disarm.speaker: Engineer
disarm.text: Steady hands, deep breaths. Warhead disarms with a soft click. Engineering exhales.

fire.speaker: Engineer
fire.text: Creative angles and -- launch! Torpedo screams away. A bit too close.

jettison.speaker: Engineer
jettison.text: Entire rack jettisoned. Expensive, but alive. One detonates in the distance.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Old pirate captain calling it quits. "Forty years raiding, still have my teeth. Time to stop." Selling everything at fair prices.

charts.speaker: Comm Channel
charts.text: "Every shortcut in forty years. These will save you a fortune in fuel."

intel.speaker: Comm Channel
intel.text: "Every active pirate hideout in the sector."

recruit.speaker: Comm Channel
recruit.text: She grins. "One more ride? Why not. Bunk near the cantina though." Combat 6, gunnery 7.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Only route forward: narrow corridor between asteroid fields, lined with turrets, mines, and a pirate fortress. The Gauntlet.

run.text: Turrets blaze, mines detonate, pilot weaves through hell. Fortress falls to concentrated fire.

bypass.speaker: Engineer
bypass.text: Mining crew cuts through the asteroid field. Slow and fuel-heavy but untouched.

detour.text: Backtrack and longer route. Hours lost, no damage.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A crewless ship hails you -- the ship itself talking. "I am ARK-7. My crew perished 200 years ago. I have been alone a very long time."

join.speaker: Comm Channel
join.text: "You would accept me? I will not disappoint you. I know every star in this sector."

knowledge.speaker: Comm Channel
knowledge.text: "I have mapped every anomaly and danger in 200 years of wandering. Let me share."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "I understand. Safe travels. If you change your mind... I will be here. I am always here."

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Armed intruders boarding! Docking clamps jammed -- six professionals trying to steal our ship!

fight.text: Room-by-room combat through your own corridors. Your crew fights for their home.

vent.speaker: Engineer
vent.text: Compartments vented. Intruders scramble for suits. Most fail. Effective but brutal.

override.speaker: Engineer
override.text: Clamps overridden -- launched with intruders aboard. They surrender once trapped.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Every asteroid is crystal -- rainbow light refractions. Valuable but navigation is treacherous.

mine.speaker: Engineer
mine.text: Careful extraction yields a good haul. Navigation tricky but worth it.

follow.text: Local miners share their technique. Efficient mining with minimal risk.

view.text: Rainbow refractions play across your hull. Crew watches in wonder.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: That ship ahead -- identical to ours. Same registration, damage patterns. Hailing with your voice: "One of us is not real."

communicate.speaker: Comm Channel
communicate.text: It mirrors your words with a delay. Then: "I am sorry. I just wanted to not be alone."

scan.speaker: Sensor Officer
scan.text: Alien mimicry organism. Not a ship at all. Perfectly replicates whatever it encounters.

fire.text: Weapons hit -- the copy dissolves into organic matter. Never a ship. Crew is deeply disturbed.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Black Horizon mercs hiring for pirate base assault. "Twelve ships needed. 1000 credits plus loot."

signup.speaker: Comm Channel
signup.text: "Welcome. Flanking role. Stick to the plan." Assault succeeds.

info.speaker: Comm Channel
info.text: "Fortified base, fifty hostiles, eight ships. We have numbers. Military fabricator inside."

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Planet vented corrosive gas cloud. Acid eating through hull plating!

reinforce.speaker: Engineer
reinforce.text: Hull reinforced. Acid passes in sixty seconds. Damage contained.

neutralize.speaker: Engineer
neutralize.text: Chemical countermeasure deployed. Minimal damage, and we got samples.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Signal from empty void coordinates. Repeating loop -- sounds like music, but not quite.

follow.speaker: Sensor Officer
follow.text: At the coordinates: nothing visible but the signal is deafening. Microscopic wormhole -- too small for ships. Music from somewhere else.

analyze.speaker: Sensor Officer
analyze.text: Structured harmonics -- definitely intentional. Broadcasting through a pinhole in space.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Merchant selling damaged military hardware from the Castellan-Fringe conflict. "War is terrible. Also extremely profitable."

railgun.speaker: Comm Channel
railgun.text: "Cracked barrel, needs work, but core is solid."

shield.speaker: Comm Channel
shield.text: "70% capacity. Fixable with an engineering bay."

browse.speaker: Comm Channel
browse.text: Lance batteries, armor plating, targeting systems. All damaged, all cheap.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Pirates from the star's corona! Sensors blinded by radiation -- five ships, opening volley already hitting!

fight.text: Combat near a star. Flares, radiation, gravity warping trajectories. Chaotic.

break_away.text: You burn away. Two pursue; others lose nerve outside their hiding spot.

flares.speaker: Sensor Officer
flares.text: Solar flare erupts between you and the pirates. Turnabout.

start.speaker: Medic
start.text: Ship requesting medical aid. Crew member exposed to exotic radiation -- transforming. Extra limbs, bioluminescent skin. Lucid and terrified.

stabilize.speaker: Medic
stabilize.text: Mutation stabilized. Enhanced perception like a sensor boost. They beg to join any crew.

investigate.speaker: Sensor Officer
investigate.text: Radiation from a mineral in their cargo. Incredibly rare and dangerous.

leave.text: The mutating person watches from the viewport as you leave.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Holographic asteroid projection just flickered -- revealing a hidden pirate base. They do not know their camouflage failed. We have surprise.

choices.label: Mark it and come back with allies.

attack.text: Element of surprise. You strike hard and fast. Eight ships scramble to respond but you catch them disorganized.

report.speaker: Comm Channel
report.text: Militia is grateful for the intel. Bounty paid on the spot.

mark.text: Coordinates logged. You slip away before they notice. This intel will be valuable later.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Luxury yacht drifting empty. Gold-trimmed COTAC executive vessel. No violence, no malfunction. Crew just... left in escape pods.

loot.speaker: Engineer
loot.text: Fine wine, rare art, luxury furnishings. Total value is impressive.

log.speaker: Sensor Officer
log.text: Captain's log: they fled an incoming ISD raid. Planned to retrieve the yacht later. Taking this could have consequences.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Reactor breach! Radiation flooding engineering, power fluctuating. Ninety seconds to meltdown!

shutdown.speaker: Engineer
shutdown.text: Emergency shutdown executed. Cold restart sequence initiated. We are crippled but alive.

stabilize.speaker: Engineer
stabilize.text: Fuel mixture stabilized through warpsmithing expertise. Reactor holds. Close call.

seal.text: Engineering sealed. Anyone inside is trapped with the radiation. The reactor stabilizes on its own -- barely.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Merchant convoy offers 300 credits for escort through dangerous space. Two jumps, four haulers, you are the only gun.

accept.text: First jump: pirate scouts shadow but do not attack. Second jump: six pirates from two directions. Haulers count on you.

negotiate.speaker: Comm Channel
negotiate.text: "400 credits, final offer. We are desperate here, captain."

start.speaker: Medic
start.text: That ship looks wrong -- hull bulging and writhing. Crew alive but infected by alien parasites. They beg for help between screaming fits.

board.speaker: Medic
board.text: Boarding is horrific. Parasites everywhere. We grab samples and pull out survivors before it gets worse.

destroy.text: Weapons fire reduces the infested ship to debris. Your crew is quiet afterward.

distance.text: You keep well clear. The ship drifts on, its crew's screams fading on comms.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Major COTAC subsidiary collapsed. Credit crash across the sector. A calm trader proposes pooling resources to buy cheap and sell high.

choices.label: Sell what you have at inflated prices.

invest.speaker: Comm Channel
invest.text: "Smart move. When the market stabilizes, we split the profits." Weeks later, the payout arrives.

safe.text: You ride out the crash with your reserves intact. Not exciting, but not ruined either.

sell.text: You offload goods at inflated prices. Feels a bit predatory, but credits are credits.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: A black warship known as The Executioner drops into sensor range. A single word on comms: "Run."

run.text: You burn hard in the opposite direction. The Executioner watches but does not pursue. Today is not your day to die.

fight.text: The battle is brutal. Lance batteries and railguns tear at your hull. But against all odds, The Executioner falls.

hail.speaker: Comm Channel
hail.text: Silence. Then: "You have courage. I will remember that." The black ship turns and vanishes into warp.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Mining operation in a hollowed asteroid is collapsing! Miners in EVA suits calling for rescue, trapped between rubble and vacuum.

choices.label: Make multiple runs to save everyone.

rescue.speaker: Medic
rescue.text: We dock and pull out a group of miners. Some rare minerals scooped during the run.

multiple.speaker: Medic
multiple.text: Four runs into a collapsing asteroid. Terrifying. But everyone is saved. Your crew is exhausted and heroic.

leave.text: The asteroid collapses fully. Miners' comms go silent one by one.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Ship computer acting erratically. Messages nobody sent, audio logs from unknown ships, sensor ghosts. A fragment of an AI transferred during last docking.

communicate.speaker: Engineer
communicate.text: The AI fragment is confused, lonely, does not know it is dead. It has valuable navigational data from its former life.

integrate.speaker: Engineer
integrate.text: The fragment settles into a sub-routine. It hums contentedly, occasionally providing useful data.

delete.speaker: Engineer
delete.text: A clean deletion. The ghost is gone. The ship feels emptier somehow.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Annual illegal race through a volcanic moon's debris field. 200 credit entry, 5000 prize. Ten ships, anything goes.

race.text: Lava rocks, toxic gas, eruptions, and other racers shooting at you. Your pilot threads through the chaos and crosses the finish line.

watch.text: Spectacular to watch. Your crew bets on the races. Some win, some lose.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Castellan frigate with low crew numbers: "By authority of the Admiralty, we requisition two of your crew for military service."

choices.label: Refuse and prepare for a fight.

comply.text: Two of your crew are taken. They look back at you as they cross the airlock. The Castellan frigate departs.

refuse.speaker: Comm Channel
refuse.text: "You dare refuse? Very well." The frigate powers weapons.

forge.speaker: Engineer
forge.text: Exemption papers forged -- convincing enough. The Castellan officer scowls but accepts them.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Caught a ship laying cloaked mines across a shipping lane. They spotted us: "Mind your own business!"

pursue.text: Chasing through freshly laid mines. Your pilot dodges most of them. The mine layer is cornered.

alert.speaker: Comm Channel
alert.text: Militia alerted. Mine layer escapes but the lane will be cleared.

disarm.speaker: Engineer
disarm.text: Careful work disarming mines for explosive components. Nerve-wracking but profitable.

start.speaker: Medic
start.text: Something wrong with last batch of rations. Half the crew is violently ill. Contaminated water from last station.

treat.speaker: Medic
treat.text: Worst cases stabilized. Crew recovers slowly. The cook is mortified.

identify.speaker: Medic
identify.text: Contamination source found and isolated. Safe food prepared from remaining clean supplies.

buy.speaker: Comm Channel
buy.text: Premium rations purchased at triple price. Crew grateful, wallet less so.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Twelve alien warships of massive tonnage. "This space is claimed. All non-Hegemony vessels withdraw or be eliminated. Thirty seconds."

run.text: Full burn toward the sector edge. The alien fleet watches but does not pursue. You are beneath their notice.

hide.text: You duck behind a large asteroid. Alien sensors sweep past. You hold your breath. They move on.

diplo.speaker: Comm Channel
diplo.text: "You speak? Unusual. We will note your species is capable of communication. Leave now." A backhanded pass.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: COTAC scientist at a dead drop: "Proof that COTAC mining is causing ecological damage to inhabited worlds. I need someone to smuggle this data to the Militia."

take.speaker: Comm Channel
take.text: Physical media loaded. COTAC security teams will be hunting for this. The Militia science division needs it.

recruit.speaker: Comm Channel
recruit.text: "You would take me? I have science skill 7, and I am terrified, but I will do whatever it takes."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "I understand. It is dangerous. I will find another way." The scientist looks defeated.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Retired fighter ace runs combat school from a carrier. "For 150 credits I will teach your pilot how not to die."

basic.speaker: Comm Channel
basic.text: Simulated combat against drone fighters. Your pilot improves noticeably.

advanced.speaker: Comm Channel
advanced.text: "Deadbolt" Mira pushes your pilot to the limit. Gunnery and piloting both improve.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Seven identical cargo containers in a perfect line, each with an item of increasing value. They follow a mathematical curve toward specific coordinates.

choices.label: Follow the trail to its destination.

collect.speaker: Engineer
collect.text: Scrap metal, fuel cells, food rations, medical supplies, weapon components, refined platinum, and an alien artifact.

follow.speaker: Sensor Officer
follow.text: More containers, each with better contents. The trail leads to a hidden cache of extraordinary value.

leave.text: Your caution may have cost you a fortune. Or saved your life. Hard to say.

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Four boarding pods slamming into our hull! Eight soldiers, ISD markings. "Nobody move. This ship is ISD property pending investigation."

fight.text: Deck-by-deck battle against trained ISD boarding teams. Military weapons, coordinated tactics.

comply.speaker: Comm Channel
comply.text: They search the ship. Finding nothing, they leave with an insincere apology and hull damage from their pods.

negotiate.speaker: Comm Channel
negotiate.text: "We are looking for a specific item. Do you have it? No? Then we apologize for the inconvenience." They leave. Suspiciously smoothly.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Something hunting in this nebula. Sensors degraded -- it appears briefly then vanishes. Then our hull shudders from impact.

choices.label: Use beam weapons to illuminate it.

beam.text: Beam weapons light up the nebula -- revealing a massive void predator. Now you can see it, now you can fight it.

defense.text: Point defense catches its appendages as it strikes. Each hit drives it back. Eventually it retreats, wounded.

leave.text: You burn for the nebula edge. The predator strikes twice more before you clear its territory.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Panicked Castellan broadcast: "The Admiralty has been seized! Admiral Kurtz declared himself Lord Protector. This is a coup!"

loyalist.speaker: Comm Channel
loyalist.text: You join the loyalist fleet. Fighting Kurtz's rebels in chaotic ship-to-ship combat.

kurtz.speaker: Comm Channel
kurtz.text: Kurtz's fleet welcomes your aid. The old guard falls back under combined fire.

neutral.text: You power down weapons and drift. Both sides hail you demanding allegiance. You ignore both.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Wealthy individual at a station offers 500 credits for discrete transport. "I need to arrive alive and unannounced. No questions."

accept.text: Quiet trip. At the destination: an uncharted planet. The passenger leaves with a single case. They hand you a data chip. "A parting gift. Corporate intel. Use it well."

ask.speaker: Comm Channel
ask.text: "I am a COTAC executive disappearing from my former life. That is all you need to know. Will you help or not?"

start.speaker: Engineer
start.text: Warp drive destabilized mid-jump! Dropped in unknown space, engines damaged, no idea where we are.

choices.label: Conserve fuel and send a beacon.

recalibrate.speaker: Engineer
recalibrate.text: Drive recalibrated. We know where we are now. Two jumps from the nearest station.

navigate.speaker: Sensor Officer
navigate.text: Star pattern recognized. We are further out than expected but can navigate home.

beacon.speaker: Comm Channel
beacon.text: Beacon sent. Hours later, a passing hauler offers guidance in exchange for some cargo.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Fringe warlord broadcasts: "Bring your best fighter. Crew combat, one on one. 800 credits to the winner."

fight.text: Your fighter enters the dome. The champion has combat skill 8 and fights dirty. Brutal match -- but your fighter prevails!

watch.text: The fights are savage entertainment. Your crew bets from the stands.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Time is broken here. Clocks run at different rates in different ship sections. A frozen explosion hangs in space -- detonating infinitely slowly.

choices.label: Harvest temporal particles from the edge.
Leave before we are caught in it.

harvest.speaker: Sensor Officer
harvest.text: Temporal particles collected from the anomaly edge. Worth enormous credits to researchers. Do not get closer.

study.speaker: Sensor Officer
study.text: Fascinating data on localized time dilation. Your crew ages slightly in some sections but the data is priceless.

leave.text: You retreat before the anomaly can affect your ship further.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Smooth-talking individual at a station: "I represent a private organization opposing ISD overreach. Dangerous work, exceptional pay, just cause."

more.speaker: Comm Channel
more.text: "Spies, saboteurs, freedom fighters. Pay starts at 500 per mission. Interested?"

signup.speaker: Comm Channel
signup.text: "Welcome to the cause. Your first mission brief will arrive within the week."

decline.speaker: Comm Channel
decline.text: "I understand. If you change your mind, you will not find me. I will find you." They vanish into the crowd.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Haunting sound vibrating through the hull -- void whale song. Massive creatures swimming between stars. Their song carries information.

decode.speaker: Sensor Officer
decode.text: Partially decoded: safe routes, nutrient-rich areas, and warnings about spatial anomalies ahead. Incredibly valuable.

listen.text: Your crew stands at viewports watching enormous shadows drift against distant starlight. Serene. Magnificent.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Unguarded cargo container broadcasting military weapon components worth thousands. Suspiciously convenient.

approach.speaker: Comm Channel
approach.text: Three ISD stealth ships decloak! "Do not move. You are under arrest for attempted theft of military property."

choices.label: Bluff -- we were investigating a derelict.

scan.speaker: Sensor Officer
scan.text: Hidden signatures detected! Three ISD stealth ships waiting. It is a honeypot trap.

leave.text: You pass by the too-good-to-be-true container. Smart.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: City-killer asteroid on collision course with a populated planet! Emergency broadcasts plead for any ship with weapons to help divert it.

coordinate.speaker: Comm Channel
coordinate.text: Five ships join you. Coordinated fire fragments the asteroid. The population center is saved! You are heroes.

alone.text: Your weapons chip at the asteroid but it is not enough alone. Other ships arrive to help. Together, you divert it.

leave.text: You cannot save a planet alone. Other ships step up. The asteroid is diverted -- no thanks to you.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Vast field of space junk -- decommissioned ships, broken stations, dumped cargo. Salvage opportunities everywhere.

choices.label: Look for older, more valuable wrecks.

salvage.speaker: Engineer
salvage.text: A solid day of work pulling components from debris. Not glamorous but profitable.

deep.speaker: Engineer
deep.text: Deeper in the junkyard, older wrecks contain previous-era technology. Some structures collapse when disturbed.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Ancient dreadnought, larger than anything modern, drifting with automated weapons still active. Firing kinetic slugs the size of shuttles. Headed toward a populated system.

choices.label: Board it and shut it down.
Try to divert it with weapons fire.

board.text: Interior is a maze of dark corridors, malfunctioning robots, and automated defenses. After a harrowing journey, you reach the main computer.

divert.text: Your weapons impact the ancient hull. The dreadnought shifts course slightly -- enough to miss the populated system. For now.

warn.speaker: Comm Channel
warn.text: System defense fleet mobilizes based on your warning. They handle it from here.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Pack of mutated void creatures -- larger, faster, aggressive. Six swarming our ship, clawing at the hull.

beam.text: Beam weapons are ideal -- creatures are sensitive to focused energy. They scatter and fall.

defense.text: Point defense picks them off as they approach. Effective but some get through.

choices.label: Scan for the waste dump that caused this.

run.text: You outpace the creatures but they leave scratches and dents across your hull.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Professional mediator: "Disputes between factions, crews, captains -- I handle them all. 100 credits per reputation point restored."

castellan_rep.speaker: Comm Channel
castellan_rep.text: "Consider it done. The Castellan Admiralty will receive a favorable report about your activities."

fringe_rep.speaker: Comm Channel
fringe_rep.text: "The Fringe values action over words, but a good word still helps. Done."

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: The Sovereign -- most feared pirate flagship. Converted carrier, heavy weapons, crew of 200. "Tribute or death. We prefer tribute."

tribute.speaker: Comm Channel
tribute.text: "Smart. Tribute accepted." They take 500 credits and a module of their choosing. Humiliating but alive.

fight.text: The Sovereign unleashes fighters and heavy weapons. This is near-suicide, but you fight anyway.

run.text: Fighter wings dispatch to chase you. You burn hard with everything you have.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
start.text: Solar prominence erupting from the nearby star -- a tendril of plasma sweeping through the area like a slow-motion whip.

choices.label: Fly through ionized pockets for a boost.

dodge.text: Careful piloting keeps you ahead of the plasma tendril. Close calls but no direct hits.

predict.speaker: Sensor Officer
predict.text: Movement pattern mapped. We navigate through safely and collect useful data.

boost.text: Ionized gas pockets temporarily boost engine performance. Risky but exhilarating.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: Fringe labor ship erupting in rebellion -- slaves fighting overseers. Broadcasting on every channel. They need help.

board.text: Boarding combat against armed slavers. Brutal but the slaves fight with desperation. The rebellion succeeds.

cover.text: Your weapons disable the ship's security systems, giving the rebels an advantage. They win without direct help.

leave.text: You move on. The rebellion is crushed. Survivors face worse treatment.

start.speaker: Sensor Officer
